definition.text: Pellagra is a disease caused by a deficiency of niacin, otherwise known as vitamin B3. It’s a form of malnutrition — specifically, micronutrient undernutrition. Niacin is crucial to cell functioning throughout your body, and the lack of it shows up in symptoms throughout your body, including your skin, mouth, bowels and brain. If left untreated, pellagra can cause lasting damage to your nervous system and even death.
